The '''First Battle of Plagen''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Plagen]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the two sides clashed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which occurred from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Before the battle started, Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Piar Nagelsa/Legends|Piar Nagelsa]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series]] [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Plagen)|tactical droid]] on the Confederate side, due to issues most tactical [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had with serving under organic leaders. The droid then assumed command as it threw away Naglesa's tactical plan, before leading the Confederate forces to win the battle.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The First Battle of Plagen was first mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|Guide]] on the conflicts in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. Although it was given the title of the First Battle of Plagen, no other battles have been confirmed to have happened on that planet.<ref name="Warfare" />
